    incomplete value and aren't hidden.

    :param ctx: Invocation context for the group.
    :param incomplete: Value being completed. May be empty.

def test_user_defined_help_param(runner):
    """A user-defined parameter named 'help' should coexist with the
    built-in --help option.
    """

    @click.command()
    @click.option("--help", "help", default=False, is_flag=True)
    def cli(help):
        click.echo(f"help={help}")

    # Invoking with the user-defined --help flag should work.
    result = runner.invoke(cli, ["--help"])
    assert result.exit_code == 0
    assert result.output == "help=True\n"

    # Invoking without it should also work.
    result = runner.invoke(cli, [])
    assert result.exit_code == 0
    assert result.output == "help=False\n"

    # The built-in help page should still be reachable via a different name.
    result = runner.invoke(cli, ["--help"], prog_name="cli")
    # Note: when both user and built-in define --help, built-in wins because
    # it is eager. The test verifies there is no crash.
    assert result.exit_code == 0


def test_user_defined_help_arg(runner):
    """A user-defined argument named 'help' should coexist with the
    built-in --help option.
    """

    @click.command()
    @click.argument("help")
    def cli(help):
        click.echo(f"help={help}")

    # Normal invocation with a positional argument.
    result = runner.invoke(cli, ["value"])
    assert result.exit_code == 0
    assert result.output == "help=value\n"

    # The built-in --help should still display help and exit cleanly.
    result = runner.invoke(cli, ["--help"])
    assert result.exit_code == 0
    assert "Show this message and exit." in result.output


def test_unknown_command(runner):
    result = runner.invoke(click.Group(), "unknown")
    assert result.exception
    assert "No such command 'unknown'." in result.output
